item.title: Cat Teasing Ball Toy Interactive Pet Supply
item.description: This SKU (YCS-PET-001) is sourced from audited Chinese factories with AQL 2.5 quality control and DDP shipping to 50+ countries. For importers, e-commerce sellers, and wholesale buyers, Cat Teasing Ball Toy Interactive Pet Supply (SKU YCS-PET-001) offers factory-direct quality at $1.03 USD per unit. Sourced from verified Chinese manufacturers with full QC documentation. Sourced from verified PET manufacturers with on-site audit. A 3-stage QC pipeline — IQC incoming-material, IPQC in-line at 4 checkpoints, OQC pre-shipment — runs on every batch, with 20-page photo + video inspection reports shared before the balance payment milestone. Compliance documents available on request.
